failure_reason: Every /c/.../c.html category page (including the assigned /home-and-garden/_/N-17h8/c.html) returns Akamai Bot Manager HTTP 418 'QVC.com is currently unavailable' on direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124), on headless Playwright, and on headed Playwright with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled (which either got 418 directly or landed on an unresolved Akamai JS sensor challenge page even after a prior homepage visit and 9-12s wait). Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome could not be tried: mcp__claude-in-chrome__list_connected_browsers returned [] and tabs_context_mcp/tabs_create_mcp reported 'Browser extension is not connected' - unavailable in this environment, not a site block. Only static sitemap XML endpoints (sitemap-us-navigation-for-the-home.xml, sitemap-us-navigation-garden-and-outdoor-living.xml, robots.txt) returned 200. Category tree/classification below is built from QVC's own sitemap URL hierarchy; exact qty and h1 verification could not be obtained for any node, so qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag on every leaf.
notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP blocked (418 Akamai) on every category page and on the assigned N-17h8 URL; robots.txt has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow (generic 'User-agent: * Allow: /'). Escalated to tier (b) Playwright headless (418) then headed with anti-detection args (418 or unresolved Akamai sensor challenge, tried twice including a homepage-first warm session) - genuine anti-bot wall defeating (a) and (b). Escalated to tier (c): Claude-in-Chrome extension not connected in this session (list_connected_browsers=[]), so tier (c) could not be attempted at all. TREE: built from QVC's authoritative sitemap-us-navigation-for-the-home.xml and sitemap-us-navigation-garden-and-outdoor-living.xml (fetched via tier-a HTTP, 200 OK) - these two departments (For The Home + Garden and Outdoor Living) together are what the assigned Home & Garden (N-17h8) department page aggregates. Where the same category ID appeared twice (once plain, once cross-tagged '.../storage-and-organization/...'), the plain canonical URL was kept and the facet duplicate dropped; the facet URL was kept only for Toys>Toy Storage, which has no plain URL in the sitemap. QTY: unobtainable for every node - all category pages blocked at every reachable tier, so no rendered header/pagination total was ever visible; qty=null + MANUAL REVIEW flag on all leaves, nothing estimated or aggregated. EXCLUDED: floor-care-and-cleaning (vacuums/mops/steamers/carpet cleaners - appliances) and cleaning-clothes-and-sponges (general cleaning cloths, not home textile); all cross-department 'storage-and-organization' facet nodes under /c/beauty/, /c/handbags-and-luggage/, /c/jewelry/, /c/electronics/, /c/kitchen-and-food/ (other departments, out of Home & Garden scope per assignment); holiday/christmas/seasonal-decorations/gift-wrap storage-facet nodes (vague seasonal bundling, no standalone storage category); sports-fan-shop/automotive/crafts-and-scrapbooking/baby(non-bedding)/pet-supplies storage-facet nodes (ambiguous or excluded per storage.md pet/baby/decorative boundaries); decorative-accents/baskets (site's primary placement is Decorative Accents, not Storage, no confirmed storage-primary function per storage.md Sec5/23); furniture/seating, cabinets-and-chests, kids-furniture, beds, office-furniture, tables, quilt-racks storage-tagged nodes (Furniture boundary - site's primary branch is Furniture, storage.md Sec21/27); rug-pads (padding accessory, not itself a floor textile); clothes-hangers, shelf-liners, drying-racks, bathroom-scales, shower-heads, bath-accessories (not container/organizer or textile products); rest of Lighting, Decorative Home Accessories, Wall Decor, Kitchen & Dining, plain Furniture, and bathroom-fixture nodes (belong to other already-validated tasks, excluded per scope). Furniture>Storage and Shelves kept in Storage at LOW confidence given the furniture/storage boundary ambiguity (storage.md Sec18/21).
